title: Plugin steps
responsibility: Lists plugin setup or resource-generation instructions and explains when no steps are provided.

inputs.name: PluginSteps.lines
inputs.description: The ordered setup or resource-generation instructions, one plain-text string per step, shown in array order without trimming, validation, or a count limit. The component checks only lines.length to choose the branch: a non-empty array renders one list item per string, an empty array renders the empty state with the text 'No steps provided.', and a null or undefined value throws a TypeError at that check.
examples: Add the plugin to the reports configuration.
Copy the template file into the plugin folder.

outputs.name: PluginSteps
outputs.description: The rendered markup for the step list: a non-empty lines array renders an hx-ul with class 'ex-reasons mod-steps' and one hx-li per string in array order, while an empty array renders an hx-div with class 'mod-steps' wrapping the EmptyState component with the text 'No steps provided.' Exactly one of the two branches renders for a given array, and the component emits no other output.
